title: Query, key and value
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from films/qkv_data.json (one attention unit of the model, recorded: block 24 head 2, not named on screen).

blocks.text: Emma's question is now a row of 100 tokens. The last one sits at the very end, where the answer is about to begin. Before the model writes a word, this last token has to find out which earlier tokens matter.
blocks.say: Emma's question is now a row of one hundred tokens. The last one sits at the very end, where the answer is about to begin. Before the model writes a word, this last token has to find out which earlier tokens matter.

blocks.text: Attention gives every token three new vectors. A query: what am I looking for? A key: what do I contain? And a value: what I will pass on, if I am chosen.
blocks.say: Attention gives every token three new vectors. A query: what am I looking for? A key: what do I contain? And a value: what I will pass on, if I am chosen.

blocks.text: All three are made from the token's own vector, by three learned matrices. In this attention unit, each one is 64 numbers long.
blocks.say: All three are made from the token's own vector, by three learned matrices. In this attention unit, each one is sixty-four numbers long.

blocks.text: Now the last token sends out its query, to every key in the row, its own included. Multiply query and key, number by number, and add it all up. That is a dot product: one score per token. When the two point the same way, the score is high.
blocks.say: Now the last token sends out its query, to every key in the row, its own included. Multiply query and key, number by number, and add it all up. That is a dot product: one score per token. When the two point the same way, the score is high.

blocks.text: Divided by 8, the square root of 64, the scores come out like this. Manchester, in Emma's question: 7.8. The Manchester in the system prompt: 5.4. Stores: 4.5. And battery, only 1.4. This attention unit is looking for a place, not an item.
blocks.say: Divided by eight, the square root of sixty-four, the scores come out like this. Manchester, in Emma's question: seven point eight. The Manchester in the system prompt: five point four. Stores: four point five. And battery, only one point four. This attention unit is looking for a place, not an item.

blocks.text: Softmax turns the scores into weights that add up to one. Every lead is magnified: 2.4 points ahead becomes ten times the weight. Manchester now takes 65 percent. The other 99 tokens share the rest.
blocks.say: Softmax turns the scores into weights that add up to one. Every lead is magnified: two point four points ahead becomes ten times the weight. Manchester now takes sixty-five percent. The other ninety-nine tokens share the rest.

blocks.text: Then the values. Each one steps forward, scaled by its weight. Manchester, at almost full strength. The rest, faint. Added together, they make one new vector of 64 numbers.
blocks.say: Then the values. Each one steps forward, scaled by its weight. Manchester, at almost full strength. The rest, faint. Added together, they make one new vector of sixty-four numbers.

blocks.text: That new vector goes back to the last token, which now carries what it found: mostly, what Manchester means in this sentence. The query asks, the keys answer, and the values are mixed by how well they matched. That is attention.
blocks.say: That new vector goes back to the last token, which now carries what it found: mostly, what Manchester means in this sentence. The query asks, the keys answer, and the values are mixed by how well they matched. That is attention.
